> Supervisor: Dr. Abhishek Srivastava, IIIT Hyderabad

## Overview

As an Amgen Scholar at IIIT Hyderabad, I worked on developing an electrochemical biosensor for rapid Tuberculosis detection, combining nanomaterial fabrication with computational aptamer optimization.

## Contributions

- Established a **ZnO nanorod based electrochemical sensor** for rapid detection of **Tuberculosis**.
- Fabricated and characterized **ZnO nanorod-modified IDEs using hydrothermal synthesis** for electrochemical biosensing.
- Developed a computational pipeline for aptamer optimization using **2D and 3D modelling** with RNA structure simulation tools.
- Extracted **sequence, structural, physicochemical, docking features and binding affinity** for aptamer–protein pairs.
- Presented at the **Amgen Asia Symposium**, University of Tokyo, engaging with 75+ researchers from across Asia and Australia.
